correctness.rationale: The claim is reduced exactly to cliques in a 120-vertex compatibility graph reconstructed from all 20 block transpositions. The symmetry, subgroup, and coset statements are checked directly on those 540 sets. The packaged verifier replays all critical finite steps without randomness or floating point.

value.rationale: Minimum distance 3 is the diameter of the n=5 block-transposition metric, so this is the canonical diameter-packing problem at the smallest order where the published n>=5 symmetry theory applies. The result gives a complete equality-case classification, not merely a recomputation of the distance table: it separates two inequivalent extremizer types and shows that only 120 of 540 maxima arise as cosets of the four cyclic order-4 subgroup maxima. These exact structural data are natural benchmarks for permutation-code constructions and for testing symmetry-based arguments in the metric.
